Notes from CMU 10-414/714 Deep Learning Systems, focused on the systems and mathematical foundations needed to build deep learning workloads.

---

::: {.content-grid}

::: {.content-card}
**[Lecture 8: Normalization, Dropout, and Model State](cmu-dlsys-lecture-8-normalization-dropout.qmd)**
Why unchanged weights can produce different predictions: normalization axes, BatchNorm running state, and dropout masks.
:::

::: {.content-card}
**[Lecture 7: Neural Network Library Abstractions](cmu-dlsys-lecture-7-neural-network-library-abstractions.qmd)**
Why residual blocks need a forward definition, not a new backward engine: modules, tensor graphs, and optimizer state.
:::

::: {.content-card}
**[Lecture 6: Optimization and Initialization](cmu-dlsys-lecture-6-optimization-initialization.qmd)**
Broadcast gradients, momentum, Adam, stochastic updates, and why initialization scale compounds with depth. Includes two explanatory animations.
:::

::: {.content-card}
**[Lecture 5: Auto Differentiation Implementation](cmu-dlsys-lecture-5-auto-differentiation-implementation.qmd)**
The general architecture of an AD library, followed by Needle's graph representation, forward execution, gradient control, and reverse-mode implementation.
:::

::: {.content-card}
**[Lecture 4: Automatic Differentiation](cmu-dlsys-lecture-4-automatic-differentiation.qmd)**
Numerical gradient checking, computation graphs, forward- and reverse-mode AD, gradient accumulation across multiple paths, and tensor reverse passes.
:::

::: {.content-card}
**[Lecture 3 Part II: Manual Neural Networks](cmu-dlsys-lecture-3-part-2-manual-neural-networks.qmd)**
Manual backpropagation for two-layer networks, matrix gradients, upstream error signals, vector-Jacobian products, and forward/backward passes.
:::

::: {.content-card}
**[Lecture 3: Manual Neural Networks](cmu-dlsys-lecture-3-manual-neural-networks.qmd)**
Linear hypothesis limitations, feature maps, nonlinear activations, two-layer networks, ReLU, fully connected networks, and why depth helps in practice.
:::

::: {.content-card}
**[Lecture 2: ML Refresher / Softmax Regression](cmu-dlsys-lecture-2-ml-refresher-softmax-regression.qmd)**
Hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, softmax regression, cross-entropy, gradient descent, SGD, and the softmax gradient.
:::
